material_findings.finding: HostAuthorization is public, Clone, caller-constructible from known digests, reusable by reference, and accepted by a generic caller-supplied executor. It cannot be the live-host authorization boundary.
PreparedExternalHostEffect::into_plan advances the session to observation-ready before an external effect has a durable outcome or exact post-state reconciliation.
Session issuance uses a process-local counter and can reproduce issuance commitments after restart.

material_findings.surface: host command execution and target binding
material_findings.finding: The plan binds raw path text and the name codex but no retained executable identity, target generation, write-ahead outcome, or partial two-command reconciliation.

A live permit requires a vetted fixed-size MAC over an explicit canonical preimage and must remain opaque, non-Clone, and non-deserializable until a separate transport envelope is independently adopted.

integration_invariants: Permit issuance atomically reserves both nonce and semantic effect key in a cross-process write-ahead ledger.
Every invalid expired replayed unsupported unpinned or stale-target refusal causes zero process spawns zero host effects and zero additional ledger writes.
Execution consumes PreparedExternalHostEffect by value and cannot release observation eligibility until the durable outcome and exact post-state are reconciled.
A crash or partial command sequence remains Ambiguous and restart reconciliation never automatically reruns it.
Execution uses a retained immutable executable object with exact argv no shell cleared environment bounded output and bounded time.
A live Codex adapter returns ObservationTransactionUnsupported unless the host supplies a real generation-stable transaction through coordinator close.

The activation commit deauthorizes HostAuthorization HostAuthorization::new execute_authorized generic production HostExecutor and PreparedExternalHostEffect::into_plan so no duplicate effect authority remains.
